title: Benchmarking and Evaluation of AI Models in Biology: Outcomes and Recommendations from the CZI Virtual Cells Workshop
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying technical and systemic challenges in benchmarking AI models for biological systems (such as imaging and transcriptomics) and provides recommendations for the scientific community. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics; discussions on data privacy and inclusivity are presented as best practices for research rather than as a core benchmarking component.
